newsitem.title: USA: Selfcare files two million share offering.
newsitem.headline: Selfcare files two million share offering.

text.p: Selfcare Inc said it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of two million shares of stock and an over-allotment option for an additional 300,000 shares.
All of such shares are being offered by the Company.
The offering is being managed by Lehman Brothers, Dillon Read & Co, and A.G. Edwards.
Selfcare also said it has entered into an agreement to acquire the U.S. rights to several nutritional supplement product lines from American Home Products Corp.
It said consideration for the product lines will consist of $30 million in cash, which it intends to finance with bank borrowings, and a $6 million promissory note to the seller.

The closing of the acquisition, which is expected to occur in February, is conditioned on the satisfaction or waiver of certain conditions, including approval of American Home's board and its obtaining financing sufficient to pay the cash portion of the acquisition consideration.
